site_events: the upper rooms were dismantled for stone
the entrance was repaired and later abandoned
origin_traditions: Families set aside a place at the table for absent relatives at the year's last gathering.
Old household tools are passed to a younger relative when a new household is formed.
Neighbours exchange small handmade tokens at the year's first gathering.
origin_histories: A generation of departing craftspeople left work unfinished; their neighbours completed it.
Several households once shared a single workshop while their own roofs were repaired.
A local craftsperson taught apprentices from more than one household.
motivations: to repay a debt of kindness
to learn a craft beyond familiar work
to find a place of their own
concerns: being unable to help those left behind
promising more than they can deliver
formative_events: finishing a difficult repair with a neighbour
taking responsibility when an older worker fell ill
finding an old repair mark beneath a newer fitting
item_conditions: well used, with a carefully oiled head
rare_marks: three shallow notches beside the maker's mark
a worn circle beneath the grip
a line of small punched dots
